summary: xAI added image, voice and multi-reference support, text-to-video generation, and native 1080p output to its existing Grok Imagine Video 1.5 model, available on grok.com, iOS/Android and via the xAI API.

practices.reason: The video model now supports image/voice reference locking, text-to-video generation, and native 1080p output, concrete and stated gains a team could use today.
practices.quote: Today it goes further: image and voice references, video from a prompt alone, and native 1080p generation.

practices.reason: New API parameters (reference_image_urls, resolution) and a new model id are live now, requiring integration work to adopt the feature.
practices.quote: Image references, text-to-video, and native 1080p are live in the xAI API with our best video model, grok-imagine-video-1.5 .
